title: Euclidean Reconstruction of Relativistic Quantum Field Theories
exact_target: Determine when a Euclidean field model can be reconstructed as a mathematically consistent relativistic quantum theory.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003668 (OWR-15960-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Reflection Positivity (2017), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2017/55, pp. 3263--3343. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 33, 34.
Osterwalder--Schrader axioms (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
OWR Report 55/2017 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The word sensible is a request to identify suitable axioms and analytic conditions. This programme does not say every Euclidean measure admits a Wightman theory or that formal Wick rotation proves reconstruction.
